_why: THE TRAP3-WRITE PROBE FOR THIS GROUP, and the canonical instance in the whole repo.
MenuRepository.cs:39 does .IgnoreEntity(e => e.BrandID) and UpsertAsync DERIVES BrandID from
the vehicle model instead - the repository's own comment at :34-38 states the failure mode
verbatim. The body below sends a brandID the derivation could never produce. If the readback
carries it, the generated mapper started writing an ignored member from client input.
Why this body cannot be all-sentinel: UpsertAsync does dto.VehicleModel.Value.ToLong(), looks
the model up, and throws a 404 when it is missing - so VehicleModel must be a REAL seeded hash
id. BasicModelCode and VehicleModel are both NotEmpty in the validator.
